notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 004 (April 9, 2025)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the state of the room wouldn't always load correctly when choosing "Continue" in the Main Menu after closing the game once.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 003 (April 8, 2025)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added Streamer Mode to Additional Settings
This mode will hide player information that streamers and other creators might not want to show to their audience.
Sorry for all the creators who already played the game before this addition!
[/list]
